title: Remove all Internet Identity login/signup prompts and flows

requirements.text: Remove Internet Identity as a required step for using the app by ensuring anonymous users can access and use the core routes ("/", "/history", and "/report/$reportId") without being redirected to, blocked by, or prompted with any Internet Identity login or signup UI.

quotes: do not want internet identity login or signup

acceptanceCriteria: When not authenticated with Internet Identity (no identity present), the user can navigate to "/" and create a report without seeing any login/signup-required screen.
When not authenticated with Internet Identity, the user can navigate to "/history" and view the history screen without seeing any login/signup-required screen.
When not authenticated with Internet Identity, the user can navigate to a valid "/report/$reportId" URL and view the report detail screen without seeing any login/signup-required screen.
No UI copy on the core routes instructs the user to sign in with Internet Identity.

requirements.text: Remove all Internet Identity login/signup user experiences from the UI: the app must not render or link to Internet Identity-specific screens or actions (e.g., LoginScreen’s "Sign In with Internet Identity" button and related messaging) anywhere in the app flow.

quotes: do not want internet identity login or signup

acceptanceCriteria: There is no navigation path in the UI that leads to an Internet Identity login screen.
No visible button/CTA in the app triggers `useInternetIdentity().login()`.
All user-facing text that mentions “Internet Identity” is removed from screens reachable through normal app navigation.

requirements.text: Keep admin-only routes protected without prompting for Internet Identity: anonymous users attempting to access "/admin/users" must see an access denied screen (not a login/signup prompt).

quotes: do not want internet identity login or signup

acceptanceCriteria: When not authenticated with Internet Identity, visiting "/admin/users" shows AccessDeniedScreen.
Anonymous users do not see any Internet Identity login prompt when attempting to access admin routes.
Admin navigation items remain hidden unless admin status is positively confirmed.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/immutablePaths (including frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, and frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts); implement changes by updating non-immutable components/pages and routing/conditional rendering.
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Implementing a new authentication provider to replace Internet Identity (e.g., email/password auth).
Adding third-party auth or external database-backed user management.
Changing backend authorization model beyond what is required to stop Internet Identity prompts in the UI.
